Page title: ThePromPromiseSouthWest Headings: About Me Homepage forms: 0 Form and button labels: Search this site | Skip to main content | Skip to navigation Visible homepage text: ThePromPromiseSouthWest Search this site Embedded Files Skip to main content Skip to navigation ThePromPromiseSouthWest Home About us How it works Our Promise How to donate Referral's The Prom Promise Founder Social Media ThePromPromiseSouthWest Home About us How it works Our Promise How to donate Referral's The Prom Promise Founder Social Media More Home About us How it works Our Promise How to donate Referral's The Prom Promise Founder Social Media About Me My name is Nicole, and I am the founder of The Prom Promise , a non-profit organisation based in the South West of England. As a registered Mental Health and Child Health Nurse, supporting young people and families has always been at the heart of everything I do. The Prom Promise was created to help ensure every young person has the opportunity to celebrate their prom with confidence, regardless of their financial circumstances. This project is incredibly close to my heart. Every day, I see the growing impact that financial hardship is having on families. For many, the cost of prom can feel completely out of reach, leaving young people worried that they will miss one of the most memorable milestones of their school years. I firmly believe that every young person deserves the chance to celebrate this special occasion with confidence, dignity, and pride, regardless of their financial circumstances. Together, we can make sure every young person has the opportunity to walk into their prom feeling valued, confident, and celebrated.
